title: PM Kisan 24th Kist: Kahin Aapka Naam Toh Nahi Chhoot Gaya? e-KYC Zaroor Karein

beats.line: Nau crore se zyada kisan parivaron ko paisa mila. Kahin aapka naam chhoot toh nahi gaya?
Sabse badi wajah hai e-KYC na hona. Bina e-KYC ke kist ruk sakti hai.
Is yojana mein paatra kisanon ko saal ke 6,000 rupaye milte hain, 2,000 ki teen kiston mein, seedha bank khaate mein.
Chhote aur seemant kisan, Aadhaar se jura bank khaata, aur satyapit zameen ke records. Ucchi aay wale peshevar aur 10,000 rupaye mahine se zyada pension wale paatra nahi hain.
Pehla, pmkisan.gov.in kholein. Doosra, e-KYC poora karein. Teesra, apna status check karein.
Sirf pmkisan.gov.in par hi jaankari bharein. Nakli link se bachein, koi bhi OTP kisi ko na dein.
Agar video kaam ka laga, subscribe karein. Agli video mein batayenge ki aur kaun si yojana mein aapka paisa chhoot raha hai.
